info.name: API Testing Portfolio
info.description:
API Testing practice project using Postman.  
Includes GET requests, HTTP status code validation,  
response body assertions, and positive and negative test scenarios.

request.description:
Purpose:  
Retrieve a specific post by its ID and validate the response data.

Method: GET

Endpoint:  
[https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/2](https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/2)

Test Coverage:

1. Verify HTTP status code is 200.
    
2. Verify post ID equals 2.
    
3. Verify post title is not empty.
    
4. Verify post body is not empty.
    

Expected Result:  
All four automated tests should pass.

Test Observation:

The API accepted a POST request with missing required fields.

Expected Result:  
HTTP 400 or 422.

Actual Result:  
HTTP 201 Created.

Conclusion:  
The API does not validate all required fields.
